# Version 3.116.0
> **Skia m116 release** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 updates to Skia m116 with broad API, WebAssembly, and platform improvements. It adds modern interop and span APIs, improves Blazor and desktop views, and refreshes the graphics engine for current .NET workloads.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy platform APIs updated** — Several obsolete and platform-specific APIs changed as part of the m116 update. Review the API diff and migrate to the current view and rendering APIs.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m116** — Refreshes the bundled renderer and native dependencies with the Chrome m116 engine release.

## API Surface

- **Drawing, image, and span APIs expanded** — Adds span overloads, SKPicture and Skottie APIs, SKBlender, raw shaders, and additional graphics interop support.

## Platform

- **WebAssembly and desktop views improved** — Improves WebAssembly compatibility and adds or updates accelerated graphics views across supported desktop and mobile platforms.

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp text-shaping binding with the corresponding native dependency refresh.
